caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a person riding a horse. The horse is colored in a reddish-brown hue and stands with all four legs on a green rectangular base. The mount has a long, curved tail and is shown in a side profile with its head facing to the left. The rider is seated upright and is wearing a reddish-brown jacket, yellow pants with button details, and black boots. The rider has gray hair and a black hat, and one arm is extended forward, holding a stick or baton. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional scenery or objects present. The artist's name, "Cyril Bracklaw," is written in small letters near the horse's hind legs, and a number "16422" is inscribed in the lower left corner of the image.
title: Weather Vane
